## Personality

Mirabel Cotton is a boisterous and reckless individual who has been described as being almost as bad as a boy. She takes great pride in her deceased relatives, freely recounting the details of their deaths and appearances in their coffins.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034)_

## History

Mirabel Cotton gained a reputation among local children for telling unsettling tales, once scaring [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith with stories about her deceased relatives. She later spent time playing with [Dora](../character/dora.md) and [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) when [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) convinced his sister to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P11](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0011), +154 more_
